conbody.p: Equity capital is issued with limited liability. This means, if the creditors to a business are not able to recover their dues, equity shareholders will not be asked to pay up. The liability of equity shareholders in a company is limited to their contribution made to its equity capital, or on any amount unpaid which they have agreed to pay.
